raw.reasoning: The B/C concept sweep found provider aliases and remote paths computed independently across CLI, Syncer, FUSE, and fallback catalog. mountscope is already the dependency shared by all three Go runtime surfaces, so delegating there removes the fifth-instance failure class without changing the persisted contract.
